outfits.name: Base (swimwear)
outfits.prompt: A young man in his early twenties with a broad-shouldered, athletic build standing 5'10", fair skin flushed pink across his cheeks and the bridge of his nose from sun exposure. His thick chestnut-brown hair is cropped short on the sides and swept back in a carelessly textured style, a few loose strands falling over his forehead. His bright hazel-green eyes are wide and round, carrying an eager, puppyish directness. He has a strong squared jaw, a slightly crooked nose, and a wide easy grin. He wears navy blue athletic swim trunks hitting just above the knee with a bold yellow side stripe, made of quick-drying polyester with a mesh lining and an elastic waistband with a white drawstring. A white flat-brim cap sits backwards on his head. His feet are bare, sand clinging to his ankles. He stands with his weight shifted onto his right leg, left knee slightly bent, hands shoved casually into the pockets of his swim trunks, shoulders loose and chest open, chin tilted up just slightly with an easy confidence.
